<function name="GetDockMargin" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the docked margins of the panel. (set by <page>Panel:DockMargin</page>)</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Left margin.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">Top margin.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">Right margin.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">Bottom margin.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
